en: Dependent on a state that is neither-with-outflows nor a cause … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is neither-without-outflows nor a cause … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are five; … under the resultant condition there is one; … under the non-disappearance condition there are five.

Dependent on a state that is neither-with-outflows nor a cause … [and so on] … dependent on a state that is neither-without-outflows nor a cause … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are five; under the object condition there are two; … under the non-disappearance condition there are five.

Dependent on a state that is neither associated with the taints (*āsava*) nor a root (*hetu*) … [etc. … dependent on a state that is dissociated from the taints and not a root … [abbreviated]. Under root-condition there are five; under object-condition there are two … [etc.

… under resultant-condition there is one … [etc. … under non-disappearance-condition there are five. Dependent on a state that is neither with taints nor without taints and not a root … [etc. … dependent on a state that is neither without taints nor with taints and not a root … [abbreviated]. Under root-condition there are five … [etc. … under resultant-condition there is one … [etc. … under non-disappearance-condition there are five.
Dependent on a state that is neither with taints nor dissociated from taints and is not a root...
Dependent on a state that is dissociated from taints but is neither with taints nor a root... pe... Dependent on a state that is dissociated from taints, is without taints, and is not a root...
pe... Dependent on a state that is dissociated from taints, is neither with taints nor without taints, and is not a root... [and so forth].
Dependent on... (Abbreviated). Five by way of root, two by way of object... pe ... five by way of non-disappearance.
